title: Port reference-global utility classes once, not as scoped copies per section
rule: When a reference class (e.g. .eyebrow, .text-link, .mono-label) is used by several sections, put its base rule in src/styles/global.scss and keep only per-section overrides scoped; do not copy the full rule into each component.
rationale: #4: SelectedWork.astro re-declared the full .eyebrow rule already scoped in Hero.astro; 5 more sections in the reference use it, so the copy would spread to 7 places.

title: Heuristic source guards need two-way self-tests on realistic markup
rule: When adding a regex/heuristic lint test (e.g. no inline copy), include negative fixtures from real reference markup (multi-class attrs, class:list objects, style={{}}, SVG, script/style) and positive fixtures for punctuation, non-ASCII, text beside {expr}, and literals inside expressions; route each file type (.astro/.ts/.tsx) to its own parser.
rationale: #2: first copy guard flagged every multi-class attribute and missed the exact title it replaced; second version parsed .ts files as Astro templates and broke on nested braces.

title: Inject the external-command runner so the live path is testable
rule: When a build script shells out (gh, git) with a fallback, take the runner as a parameter (runGh = ghJson) and table-test the success, partial-failure and not-found paths with stubs; a suite that only runs with the tool absent proves only the fallback.
rationale: #9: every exporter test stripped gh from PATH, so fetchMeta building meta, the committed/live merge and the PR match were never run; cycle 1 High.

title: Layout-stability tests must control image loading
rule: Prove CLS 0 by blocking (route.abort) or delaying images and asserting layout boxes are identical with and without the image; a buffered layout-shift observer passes vacuously when the shifting element is below the fold or the local image loads instantly.
rationale: #3: the first CLS test stayed green after removing every min-height and putting the portrait back in flow (mutation probe).

title: Astro inlines stylesheets by default, which breaks CSP default-src 'self'
rule: Keep build.inlineStylesheets: 'never' and never add inline <style>/<script> or set:html styles; the dist test asserts no inline style or script.
rationale: #1: Astro's default 'auto' inlined global.scss into every page, which a CSP of default-src 'self' blocks, so the site would render unstyled.

title: Build-time render branches need a reachable test
rule: When an .astro page renders an alternative branch from build-time data (empty dataset, noscript fallback), move the decision into a pure function with a unit test for the empty/edge input, because browser tests only ever see the real built data.
rationale: #11: the <noscript> empty-dataset branch in build.astro could not be reached by any test; routeBuildPayload only rewrites client data.

title: New schema URL/email constraints need negative-case unit tests
rule: When adding an href or email field to site.schema.ts, add a unit test that rejects javascript:, http:, relative and empty values (or malformed emails) at that path, like the existing cvHref/pureContextHref tests; e2e tests that compare rendered hrefs to site.ts pass for any value.
rationale: #8: githubHref, linkedinHref and email were added with no rejection tests.

title: Pending-target tests need a loud re-enable trigger
rule: When a test must wait for later issues (test.fixme / skip), assert against an explicit pending list that fails both when a pending target appears and when a non-pending one is missing, so each later issue is forced to update it.
rationale: #4: the selected-work link-target check was a single all-or-nothing test.fixme; a mis-named section id in #5-#7 would never turn it red.

title: Pin data lengths that CSS grids hard-code
rule: If a component hard-codes repeat(N, 1fr) for a content array, enforce .length(N) in site.schema.ts (or derive the track count from the data) so a content edit fails at the schema, not as an orphan grid row.
rationale: #5: portals/foundation/metrics grids use repeat(5/4/3) while the schema only requires .min(1).

title: Scope axe exclusions to the known nodes, never disable a whole rule
rule: When an axe run must tolerate a known violation (e.g. a reference token under AA), exclude only the offending nodes or filter violations to that exact colour pair; never disableRules(['color-contrast']) for a whole section, and name the follow-up in the test comment.
rationale: #6: disabling color-contrast for #ai to tolerate --teal on --bg (4.49:1) also stopped checking every new grey in the section and hid the new PureContext link's failure.

title: Sort recorded timestamps as dates, not strings
rule: Sort ts values that carry a local UTC offset with Date.parse, not localeCompare; string order breaks across DST offset changes and disagrees with the dashboard's date sort.
rationale: #11: the noscript runs table sorted +02:00 timestamps with localeCompare while the dashboard sorts by getTime().

title: Visual-match criteria need token-level assertions
rule: For a 'matches the reference' criterion, assert a few computed styles per breakpoint (section padding, heading/intro font-size, mono font-family) with toHaveCSS, not only grid column counts and overflow.
rationale: #4: RoleFit/SelectedWork tests only checked column counts, so a swapped spacing or type token would drift from the reference with a green suite.

title: A sticky header needs a matching scroll-padding-top
rule: When making a header sticky, set html scroll-padding-top from the same header-height tokens (per breakpoint, plus the safe-area inset) so in-page anchors do not land under it.
rationale: #3: the sticky header covered every /#section target, including the monogram's /#top.

title: Attribute-pairing assertions must rule out null == null
rule: When asserting that two attributes reference each other (aria-controls/id, for/id, aria-labelledby), first assert the value is non-empty, then match it; an equality of two getAttribute results passes when both are missing.
rationale: #12: expect(table.id).toBe(button.aria-controls) would pass with both attributes removed.

title: Bundle-size budgets must sum the imported chunk graph
rule: When asserting a JS size budget for an island or page script, follow the entry chunk's static imports in dist/_astro and sum their gzipped sizes; state explicitly which shared framework chunks are excluded. Measuring only the entry file lets split-out code grow unchecked.
rationale: #12: the <6 KB test gzipped only the component-url entry (1.2 KB) while its imports brought the real cost to 5.4 KB.

title: File mtimes are checkout time in a static build
rule: Do not ship fs.stat mtime as a 'data updated' time from a prebuild step; on CI/Cloudflare it is the clone time. Derive freshness from the data (max ts) or git log, or label the field as file time.
rationale: #9: the exporter copied the live dashboard server's stat().mtime, so the frozen toprope dataset would read as updated on every deploy.

title: File-scanning tests must resolve paths from the test file and fail on zero files
rule: Resolve repo paths via new URL('../..', import.meta.url), only swallow ENOENT, and assert the scanned file count is > 0 so the test cannot pass vacuously.
rationale: #2: the copy guard passed with zero files when run from another cwd.

title: Grid column-count helpers must fail on non-grid elements
rule: When counting columns via getComputedStyle(el).gridTemplateColumns, first assert display is grid (the value is 'none' otherwise and splits to 1), or pair a 'one column' check with a geometric check that items stack.
rationale: #5: columnCount returned 1 for any non-grid element, so the 390px metrics 'one column' check could pass after a display change.

title: Image byte budgets must be measured at high device pixel ratios
rule: When testing a total-image-bytes budget for responsive images (srcset/sizes), run it at deviceScaleFactor 2-3 as well as 1, and state whether fallback formats count; a DPR-1 run under-reports real retina downloads by ~2.5x.
rationale: #7: the 600 KB homepage budget test ran only at DPR 1 (97 KB) while DPR 2 downloads 260 KB; jpg fallbacks were never measured.

title: Keep -webkit-background-clip for gradient text
rule: When text uses color: transparent with background-clip: text, also declare -webkit-background-clip: text; there is no autoprefixer and older Chromium/WebKit otherwise render invisible text.
rationale: #3: the hero h1 emphasis dropped the prefixed declaration the reference had.

title: Negative UI assertions must first prove the element rendered
rule: Before a not.toContainText / toBeHidden style assertion on a rendered region, assert something positive and exact about that region (heading list, row count) so the negative check cannot pass on zero matches.
rationale: #10: the 'no dispositions' test passed whether or not the detail row opened; the 'unknown hash' test ran after the page was already on the expected value.

title: No conditional assertions in tests
rule: Do not wrap an expect in if (value) based on the current data; pick fixtures that exercise each branch (e.g. one row with meta, one without) and assert both unconditionally, so neither branch can be skipped silently.
rationale: #11: the noscript test did if (url) await expect(link)..., so the no-meta plain-text branch was never asserted and the link check could skip.

title: Redraw-everything renderers must not rerender on every resize
rule: In a vanilla render-all dashboard, only redraw width-dependent charts, and only when the container width actually changed; a full rebuild on window resize resets scroll positions and drops focus on elements without a focus key.
rationale: #10: resize handler rebuilt the runs table and charts, so mobile URL-bar resizes could reset horizontal scroll and lose keyboard focus.

title: Repeated reference colours become tokens, not per-component literals
rule: When a reference colour (e.g. the #fbfbf9 alt-band tint) is used by more than one section, add it once as a custom property in src/styles/tokens.scss and read it with var(); do not add another hex literal or local SCSS variable.
rationale: #8: Background.astro added a fourth hard-coded #fbfbf9 while the same diff tokenised the dark band.

title: Scanner loops must advance on failed searches
rule: In hand-written scanners, check indexOf/search results for -1 before assigning the cursor; fail fast with a message instead of resetting the index.
rationale: #2: an unterminated attribute quote made indexOf return -1, reset the cursor to 0 and hung npm run check.

title: Tests must exercise the built site, not a stale dist or a reused dev server
rule: Run npm run build before npm run test; Playwright serves astro preview on its own port with reuseExistingServer: false; assert shipped output (computed styles, dist files), not source text.
rationale: #1: the token parity test read SCSS source only, and the smoke tests could reuse a running astro dev on 4321 or an old dist and pass falsely.

title: Use GitHub's own issue-PR link, not a hand-written closing-keyword regex
rule: To find the PR that closed an issue, read gh pr list --json closingIssuesReferences instead of regex-matching PR bodies or branch names; body regexes attach follow-up PRs that mention 'fixes #n' and need their own test matrix.
rationale: #9: prForIssue re-implemented close/fix/resolve parsing plus a branch-name match; three lenses flagged it (wrong PR on later mentions, body branch untested).
